headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 19, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nathan Lukes leading the Blue Jays' offense. The Cleveland Guardians took down the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2, with Parker Messick earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. The Minnesota Twins dominated the Texas Rangers 9-3, with Trevor Larnach hitting 3 home runs and driving in 3 runs. The Seattle Mariners shut down the Baltimore Orioles 3-0, with Bryan Woo pitching 7.0 innings and Andrés Muñoz earning the save.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain with the Los Angeles Angels. Everson Pereira has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion for the Chicago White Sox. Cole Ragans has been placed on the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement for the Kansas City Royals. Spencer Strider has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation for the Atlanta Braves. Chase DeLauter has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 14, 2026, with a right side rib fracture for the Cleveland Guardians. Max Scherzer has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 14, 2026, with back spasms for the Toronto Blue Jays. Gleyber Torres has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 16, 2026, with a left oblique strain for the Detroit Tigers. Will Wilson has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a left thumb fracture for the Seattle Mariners.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded catcher Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Kansas City Royals traded right-hander Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought win over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Parker Messick earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Rangers 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-3 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Trevor Larnach leading the offense and Joe Ryan dominating on the mound. Larnach hit 3 home runs, drove in 3 runs, and went 5 for 5 at the plate, while Ryan pitched 5 strong innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Orioles in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 3-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Bryan Woo pitching 7.0 innings and allowing 3 hits, 1 walk, and 0 earned runs while striking out 9 batters. Andrés Muñoz earned the save in the shutout victory.

top_news.title: **Trout Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels center fielder Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Stratton Heads to Pittsburgh in Trade**
top_news.summary: Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates, joining the team after being acquired from the Atlanta Braves. The trade sent catcher Joey Bart to the Braves in exchange for Stratton.
